# Source:subId

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.2</span></div>

Get or set the subId of the source if it is a CRSF or a FrSky sensor.

```lua
local crsfId = source:subId([crsfId])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crsfId` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

crsfId (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source = system.getSource({name="Tx SNR"})
print(source:name() .. " module:" .. source:module() .. " crsfId:" .. source:crsfId()) .. " subId:" .. source:subId())
```
